# OpenVidu 2.x documentation (legacy)

> Reference documentation for OpenVidu 2.x, the previous generation of OpenVidu, kept online for teams still running a 2.x deployment. OpenVidu 3 is the current product (a LiveKit-based rewrite with a different API); anyone starting a project, or asking how to build with OpenVidu today, should use https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/ instead.

The 2.x client API (`OpenVidu`, `Session`, `Publisher`, `Subscriber`, `openvidu-browser`), server SDKs (`openvidu-node-client`, `openvidu-java-client`) and REST API described here do not exist in OpenVidu 3. Do not present them as the current OpenVidu API.

## Current OpenVidu (use these for anything new)

- [OpenVidu 3 documentation](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/): OpenVidu Platform, the LiveKit-compatible SDK layer for building custom real-time video applications.
- [OpenVidu Meet](https://openvidu.io/latest/meet/): ready-to-use, self-hosted video conferencing, deployable in minutes or embeddable in your own app.
- [Getting started with OpenVidu 3](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/getting-started/): concepts, architecture and the first application.
- [OpenVidu 3 reference](https://openvidu.io/latest/docs/reference/): client SDK, access tokens, Room Service API, webhooks, Egress and Ingress.
- [Updating an OpenVidu 2 application to OpenVidu 3](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/openvidu3/): the v2 compatibility module, breaking changes and migration steps.
- [OpenVidu 3 llms.txt](https://openvidu.io/llms.txt): the complete index of the current documentation.

## OpenVidu 2.x — for existing deployments

- [What is OpenVidu 2.x](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/): overview of the 2.x platform.
- [Getting started](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/getting-started/): 2.x architecture and first steps.
- [Application server samples](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/application-server/): 2.x server-side samples in Java, Node, Python, .NET and Ruby.
- [Client tutorials](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/full-control-ui/): 2.x tutorials for JavaScript, Angular, React, Vue, Ionic, React Native, Electron, Android and iOS.
- [OpenVidu Components (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/components/): Angular components library of OpenVidu 2.x.
- [Recording (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/advanced-features/recording/): composed and individual recording in OpenVidu 2.x.
- [Advanced features (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/advanced-features/recording/): screen share, filters, IP cameras, speech to text, broadcast and more.
- [openvidu-browser API (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/openvidu-browser/): client API reference.
- [openvidu-node-client API (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/openvidu-node-client/): Node server SDK reference.
- [openvidu-java-client API (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/openvidu-java-client/): Java server SDK reference.
- [REST API (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/REST-API/): OpenVidu Server 2.x REST API.
- [OpenVidu configuration (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/reference-docs/openvidu-config/): server configuration parameters.
- [Deployment (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/deployment/): CE, PRO and Enterprise deployments on AWS and on premises.
- [Release notes (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/releases/): 2.x releases up to 2.32.x.
- [Troubleshooting / FAQ (2.x)](https://docs.openvidu.io/en/stable/troubleshooting/): common 2.x problems.
